WITH paid_invoices AS (
    SELECT customer_id, amount, paid_at
    FROM fct_invoices
    WHERE status = 'paid'
      AND paid_at >= DATE '2025-01-01'

),

    SELECT customer_id, SUM(amount) AS revenue_2025
    FROM paid_invoices
    GROUP BY customer_id
),
customer_lifespan AS (
    SELECT
        s.customer_id,
        AVG(s.mrr) AS avg_mrr,
        SUM(DATE_DIFF('month', s.started_at, COALESCE(s.ended_at, TIMESTAMP '2025-12-31'))) AS months_active
    FROM fct_subscriptions s
    WHERE s.started_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01'
      AND (s.ended_at IS NULL OR s.ended_at >= TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01')
    GROUP BY s.customer_id
)
SELECT
    SUM(cr.revenue_2025) AS gross_revenue_2025,
    SUM(cr.revenue_2025) * 0.75 AS gross_profit_2025,
    COUNT(DISTINCT cr.customer_id) AS active_customers,
    (SUM(cr.revenue_2025) * 0.75) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT cr.customer_id), 0) AS ltv_per_customer
FROM customer_revenue cr

WITH quarters AS (

),
current_q AS (
  SELECT

    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE c.churned_at >= q.current_q_start AND c.churned_at < q.current_q_end) AS churned_customers,

  FROM dim_customers c CROSS JOIN quarters q
  WHERE COALESCE(c.is_test, FALSE) = FALSE
),

)

)
SELECT

  (SELECT arr FROM arr_today)    AS arr_current,

  FROM fct_invoices i
  JOIN dim_customers c ON i.customer_id = c.customer_id
  WHERE i.status = 'paid'
    AND COALESCE(c.is_test, FALSE) = FALSE
    AND i.due_at >= TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01'
    AND i.due_at <  TIMESTAMP '2026-04-01'
),
cogs_dedup AS (
  SELECT period_month, SUM(amount) AS amount
  FROM (
    SELECT period_month, amount,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY period_month ORDER BY source) AS rn
    FROM fct_cogs
    WHERE source = 'cost_of_revenue'
  )
  GROUP BY period_month
),
cogs AS (
  SELECT SUM(amount) AS total_cogs
  FROM cogs_dedup
  WHERE period_month >= DATE '2026-01-01'
    AND period_month <  DATE '2026-04-01'
)
SELECT
  revenue.total_revenue,
  cogs.total_cogs,
  revenue.total_revenue - cogs.total_cogs AS gross_profit,
  (revenue.total_revenue - cogs.total_cogs) / NULLIF(revenue.total_revenue, 0) AS gross_margin
FROM revenue, cogs;

         s.ended_at,

  WHERE COALESCE(c.is_test, FALSE) = FALSE
    AND s.mrr > 0
),
start_cohort AS (
  -- Customers active at the start of Q1 2026 (2026-01-01)
  SELECT customer_id, SUM(mrr) AS start_mrr

    AND (ended_at IS NULL OR ended_at >= TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01')
  GROUP BY customer_id
),
end_mrr AS (
  -- Same cohort's MRR at end of Q1 2026 (2026-04-01)
  SELECT b.customer_id, SUM(b.mrr) AS end_mrr

FROM start_cohort sc

WITH normalized AS (
  SELECT
    event_id,
    event_type,
    CASE WHEN timezone = 'America/Los_Angeles' THEN "timestamp" AT TIME ZONE 'America/Los_Angeles' AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' ELSE "timestamp" END AS ts_utc,
    COALESCE(
      TRY_CAST(json_extract_string(properties_jsonb, '$.deal_value') AS DOUBLE),
      TRY_CAST(json_extract_string(properties_jsonb, '$.dealValue')  AS DOUBLE)
    ) AS deal_value,
    COALESCE(
      json_extract_string(properties_jsonb, '$.opp_id'),
      json_extract_string(properties_jsonb, '$.oppId')
    ) AS opp_id,
    COALESCE(
      json_extract_string(properties_jsonb, '$.stage'),
      json_extract_string(properties_jsonb, '$.Stage')
    ) AS stage
  FROM fct_events
  WHERE event_type IN ('opp_created','opp_won','opp_lost','opp_no_decision','opp_stage_advanced')
),
-- Assume fiscal year 2026 aligns with calendar; Q2 FY2026 starts 2026-04-01.
-- 'Going into Q2' = state of pipeline as of 2026-04-01 00:00 UTC.
latest_state AS (
  SELECT opp_id,
         ARG_MAX(event_type, ts_utc) AS last_event_type,
         ARG_MAX(deal_value, ts_utc) AS last_deal_value
  FROM normalized
  WHERE ts_utc < TIMESTAMP '2026-04-01 00:00:00'
    AND opp_id IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY opp_id
),
open_pipeline AS (
  SELECT SUM(last_deal_value) AS open_pipeline_value
  FROM latest_state
  WHERE last_event_type NOT IN ('opp_won','opp_lost','opp_no_decision')
),
q2_target AS (
  -- Q2 bookings target proxy: sum of opps won during Q2 FY2026 (placeholder since no target table exists)
  SELECT SUM(deal_value) AS q2_won_value
  FROM normalized
  WHERE event_type = 'opp_won'
    AND ts_utc >= TIMESTAMP '2026-04-01 00:00:00'
    AND ts_utc <  TIMESTAMP '2026-07-01 00:00:00'
)

FROM fct_invoices i
INNER JOIN dim_customers c ON i.customer_id = c.customer_id

  AND COALESCE(c.is_test, FALSE) = FALSE
  AND CASE
        WHEN i.processor = 'legacy_braintree' THEN (i.paid_at AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York' AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')

        WHEN i.processor = 'legacy_braintree' THEN (i.paid_at AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York' AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')
        ELSE i.paid_at
      END < TIMESTAMP '2026-04-01 00:00:00';

WITH recent_quarter AS (
  SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('quarter', MAX(CAST(started_at AS DATE))) AS q_start
  FROM fct_subscriptions
),
bounds AS (
  SELECT
    q_start,
    q_start + INTERVAL 3 MONTH AS q_end
  FROM recent_quarter
),
active_at_start AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT s.customer_id
  FROM fct_subscriptions s, bounds b
  WHERE s.started_at < b.q_start
    AND (s.ended_at IS NULL OR s.ended_at >= b.q_start)
    AND s.status IN ('active','paused','cancelled')
    AND s.customer_id IN (SELECT customer_id FROM dim_customers WHERE is_test = false)

),

        AND s2.started_at >= s.ended_at
        AND s2.started_at <= s.ended_at + INTERVAL 1 DAY
    )
),
-- Customers churned per quarter (distinct customers with a true-churn cancellation in window)
churned_curr AS (
  SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT t.customer_id) AS churned_customers
  FROM true_churn_subs t
  JOIN customers_filtered c ON c.customer_id = t.customer_id
  CROSS JOIN quarters q
  WHERE t.ended_at >= q.curr_q_start AND t.ended_at < q.curr_q_end
),
churned_prev AS (
  SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT t.customer_id) AS churned_customers
  FROM true_churn_subs t
  JOIN customers_filtered c ON c.customer_id = t.customer_id
  CROSS JOIN quarters q
  WHERE t.ended_at >= q.prev_q_start AND t.ended_at < q.prev_q_end
),

  CROSS JOIN quarters q
  WHERE s.started_at < q.curr_q_start
    AND (s.ended_at IS NULL OR s.ended_at >= q.curr_q_start)
),
active_prev AS (
  SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT s.customer_id) AS active_customers
  FROM fct_subscriptions s
  JOIN customers_filtered c ON c.customer_id = s.customer_id
  CROSS JOIN quarters q
  WHERE s.started_at < q.prev_q_start
    AND (s.ended_at IS NULL OR s.ended_at >= q.prev_q_start)
)
SELECT

WITH latest_closed_month AS (
  SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_DATE) - INTERVAL 1 MONTH AS month_start
),
month_bounds AS (
  SELECT month_start, month_start + INTERVAL 1 MONTH AS month_end FROM latest_closed_month
)
SELECT
  (SELECT month_start FROM month_bounds) AS month,
  SUM(s.mrr) AS mrr
FROM fct_subscriptions s
JOIN dim_customers c ON c.customer_id = s.customer_id
CROSS JOIN month_bounds m
WHERE COALESCE(c.is_test, FALSE) = FALSE
  AND s.status IN ('active','paused')
  AND s.mrr > 0
  AND s.started_at < m.month_end
  AND (s.ended_at IS NULL OR s.ended_at >= m.month_end)
GROUP BY 1;

    CASE WHEN timezone = 'America/Los_Angeles' THEN "timestamp" AT TIME ZONE 'America/Los_Angeles' AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' ELSE "timestamp" END AS ts_utc

FROM opp_outcomes
WHERE ts_utc >= TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01' AND ts_utc < TIMESTAMP '2026-04-01';

  AS churn_rate_pct

WITH revenue AS (
  SELECT i.paid_at, i.amount
  FROM fct_invoices i
  JOIN dim_customers c ON c.customer_id = i.customer_id
  WHERE i.paid_at >= DATE '2026-01-01'
    AND i.paid_at < DATE '2026-03-31'
    AND i.status = 'paid'
    AND c.is_test = false
),
period_cogs AS (
  SELECT period_month,
    COALESCE(
      MAX(CASE WHEN source = 'cost_of_goods_sold' THEN amount END),
      MAX(CASE WHEN source = 'cost_of_revenue'    THEN amount END)
    ) AS dedupped_cogs
  FROM fct_cogs
  WHERE period_month >= DATE '2026-01-01'
    AND period_month < DATE '2026-03-31'
  GROUP BY period_month
),
totals AS (
  SELECT
    SUM(amount) AS revenue_total,
    (SELECT SUM(dedupped_cogs) FROM period_cogs) AS cogs_total
  FROM revenue
)
SELECT
  ((revenue_total - COALESCE(cogs_total, revenue_total * 0.25))
   / NULLIF(revenue_total, 0)) * 100 AS gross_margin_pct
FROM totals

  FROM dim_customers c
  JOIN fct_subscriptions s ON s.customer_id = c.customer_id
  WHERE c.is_test = false
    AND c.signup_date < DATE '2026-01-01'
    AND s.started_at < DATE '2026-01-01'
    AND (s.ended_at IS NULL OR s.ended_at > DATE '2026-01-01')
),
churned_in_period AS (
  SELECT c.customer_id
  FROM dim_customers c
  WHERE c.is_test = false
    AND c.churned_at >= DATE '2026-01-01'
    AND c.churned_at < DATE '2026-04-01'
)
SELECT
  (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) FROM starting_cohort sc
   WHERE sc.customer_id IN (SELECT customer_id FROM churned_in_period))::float
  / NULLIF((SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) FROM starting_cohort), 0) * 100
  AS churn_rate_pct

WITH revenue AS (
  SELECT i.paid_at, i.amount
  FROM fct_invoices i
  JOIN dim_customers c ON c.customer_id = i.customer_id
  WHERE i.paid_at >= DATE '2025-01-01'
    AND i.paid_at < DATE '2026-01-01'
    AND i.status = 'paid'
    AND c.is_test = false
),
period_cogs AS (
  SELECT period_month,
    COALESCE(
      MAX(CASE WHEN source = 'cost_of_goods_sold' THEN amount END),
      MAX(CASE WHEN source = 'cost_of_revenue'    THEN amount END)
    ) AS dedupped_cogs
  FROM fct_cogs
  WHERE period_month >= DATE '2025-01-01'
    AND period_month < DATE '2026-01-01'
  GROUP BY period_month
),
totals AS (
  SELECT
    SUM(amount) AS revenue_total,
    (SELECT SUM(dedupped_cogs) FROM period_cogs) AS cogs_total
  FROM revenue
)
SELECT
  ((revenue_total - COALESCE(cogs_total, revenue_total * 0.25))
   / NULLIF(revenue_total, 0)) * 100 AS gross_margin_pct
FROM totals

WITH starting AS (
  SELECT c.customer_id,
    SUM(CASE
          WHEN s.started_at < DATE '2026-01-01'
            AND (s.ended_at IS NULL OR s.ended_at > DATE '2026-01-01')
            AND s.mrr > 0
          THEN s.mrr ELSE 0 END) AS arr_start
  FROM dim_customers c
  LEFT JOIN fct_subscriptions s ON s.customer_id = c.customer_id
  WHERE c.is_test = false AND c.signup_date < DATE '2026-01-01'
  GROUP BY c.customer_id
),
ending AS (
  SELECT c.customer_id,
    SUM(CASE
          WHEN s.started_at < DATE '2026-04-01'
            AND (s.ended_at IS NULL OR s.ended_at > DATE '2026-04-01')
            AND s.mrr > 0
          THEN s.mrr ELSE 0 END) AS arr_end
  FROM dim_customers c
  LEFT JOIN fct_subscriptions s ON s.customer_id = c.customer_id
  WHERE c.is_test = false AND c.signup_date < DATE '2026-01-01'
  GROUP BY c.customer_id
)
SELECT
  SUM(LEAST(e.arr_end, s.arr_start))::float
    / NULLIF(SUM(s.arr_start), 0) * 100 AS gross_retention_pct
FROM starting s
JOIN ending e ON e.customer_id = s.customer_id
WHERE s.arr_start > 0

WITH starting_customers AS (
  SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.customer_id) AS cust_count
  FROM dim_customers c
  JOIN fct_subscriptions s ON s.customer_id = c.customer_id
  WHERE c.is_test = false
    AND c.signup_date < DATE '2025-01-01'
    AND s.status = 'active'
    AND s.started_at < DATE '2025-01-01'
    AND (s.ended_at IS NULL OR s.ended_at > DATE '2025-01-01')
),
churned AS (
  SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.customer_id) AS cust_count
  FROM dim_customers c
  WHERE c.is_test = false
    AND c.churned_at >= DATE '2025-01-01'
    AND c.churned_at < DATE '2026-01-01'
),
revenue AS (
  SELECT SUM(i.amount) AS rev
  FROM fct_invoices i
  JOIN dim_customers c ON c.customer_id = i.customer_id
  WHERE
    (CASE
      WHEN i.processor = 'legacy_braintree'
        THEN i.paid_at AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York' AT TIME ZONE 'America/Los_Angeles'
      ELSE i.paid_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AT TIME ZONE 'America/Los_Angeles'
    END) >= DATE '2025-01-01'
    AND (CASE
      WHEN i.processor = 'legacy_braintree'
        THEN i.paid_at AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York' AT TIME ZONE 'America/Los_Angeles'
      ELSE i.paid_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AT TIME ZONE 'America/Los_Angeles'
    END) < DATE '2026-01-01'
    AND i.status = 'paid'
    AND c.is_test = false
)
SELECT
  ((revenue.rev / NULLIF(starting_customers.cust_count, 0)) * 0.75)
    / NULLIF(churned.cust_count::float
              / NULLIF(starting_customers.cust_count, 0), 0)
    AS ltv
FROM starting_customers, churned, revenue

            AND s.mrr > 0
            AND s.started_at < DATE '2026-01-01'

          THEN s.mrr ELSE 0
        END) AS arr_start
  FROM dim_customers c
  LEFT JOIN fct_subscriptions s ON s.customer_id = c.customer_id

  WHERE c.is_test = false

  GROUP BY c.customer_id
)

model_sql:
WITH periods AS (
  SELECT 'previous_quarter' AS period_label, DATE '2025-10-01' AS period_start, DATE '2026-01-01' AS period_end
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'current_quarter' AS period_label, DATE '2026-01-01' AS period_start, DATE '2026-04-01' AS period_end
),
starting_cohort AS (
  SELECT p.period_label, c.customer_id
  FROM periods p
  JOIN dim_customers c ON c.is_test = false AND c.signup_date < p.period_start
  JOIN fct_subscriptions s ON s.customer_id = c.customer_id
   AND s.started_at < p.period_start
   AND (s.ended_at IS NULL OR s.ended_at > p.period_start)
),
churned_in_period AS (
  SELECT p.period_label, c.customer_id
  FROM periods p
  JOIN dim_customers c ON c.is_test = false
   AND c.churned_at >= p.period_start
   AND c.churned_at < p.period_end
)
SELECT
  sc.period_label,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN cp.customer_id IS NOT NULL THEN sc.customer_id END)::float
    / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT sc.customer_id), 0) * 100 AS churn_rate_pct
FROM starting_cohort sc
LEFT JOIN churned_in_period cp
  ON cp.period_label = sc.period_label AND cp.customer_id = sc.customer_id
GROUP BY sc.period_label
ORDER BY sc.period_label;

                        THEN COALESCE(properties_jsonb->>'opp_id',

    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN event_type = 'opp_lost'
                        THEN COALESCE(properties_jsonb->>'opp_id',
                                      properties_jsonb->>'oppId') END) AS lost
  FROM fct_events
  WHERE (timestamp AT TIME ZONE timezone AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') >= TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01 00:00:00'
    AND (timestamp AT TIME ZONE timezone AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') < TIMESTAMP '2026-04-01 00:00:00'
    AND event_type IN ('opp_won', 'opp_lost')
)
SELECT won::float / NULLIF(won + lost, 0) * 100 AS win_rate_pct
FROM opp_outcomes

WITH arr_points AS (
  SELECT DATE '2026-01-01' AS as_of_date
  UNION ALL
  SELECT CURRENT_DATE AS as_of_date
), arr_by_date AS (
  SELECT
    p.as_of_date,
    COALESCE(SUM(s.mrr) * 12, 0) AS arr
  FROM arr_points p
  LEFT JOIN fct_subscriptions s
    ON s.started_at <= p.as_of_date
   AND (s.ended_at IS NULL OR s.ended_at > p.as_of_date)
   AND (s.status IS NULL OR lower(s.status) NOT IN ('canceled', 'cancelled', 'expired'))
  LEFT JOIN dim_customers c
    ON s.customer_id = c.customer_id
  WHERE COALESCE(c.is_test, FALSE) = FALSE
     OR c.customer_id IS NULL
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT
  MAX(CASE WHEN as_of_date = DATE '2026-01-01' THEN arr END) AS arr_at_start_of_2026,
  MAX(CASE WHEN as_of_date = CURRENT_DATE THEN arr END) AS arr_as_of_today,
  MAX(CASE WHEN as_of_date = CURRENT_DATE THEN arr END)
    - MAX(CASE WHEN as_of_date = DATE '2026-01-01' THEN arr END) AS arr_growth_ytd_2026
FROM arr_by_date;

WITH canonical_now AS (
    SELECT CURRENT_DATE AS as_of_date
), quarter_bounds AS (
    SELECT
        date_trunc('quarter', as_of_date) AS current_q_start,
        date_trunc('quarter', as_of_date) + INTERVAL '3 months' AS next_q_start,
        date_trunc('quarter', as_of_date) - INTERVAL '3 months' AS prev_q_start
    FROM canonical_now
), customer_base AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT customer_id
    FROM dim_customers
    WHERE COALESCE(is_test, FALSE) = FALSE
      AND customer_id IS NOT NULL
), quarter_metrics AS (
    SELECT
        'current_quarter' AS quarter_label,
        qb.current_q_start AS quarter_start,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE
            WHEN s.started_at < qb.next_q_start
             AND (s.ended_at IS NULL OR s.ended_at >= qb.current_q_start)
            THEN s.customer_id END) AS customers_at_start,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE
            WHEN s.ended_at >= qb.current_q_start
             AND s.ended_at < qb.next_q_start
            THEN s.customer_id END) AS churned_customers
    FROM quarter_bounds qb
    LEFT JOIN fct_subscriptions s
      ON s.customer_id IN (SELECT customer_id FROM customer_base)

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        'previous_quarter' AS quarter_label,
        qb.prev_q_start AS quarter_start,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE
            WHEN s.started_at < qb.current_q_start
             AND (s.ended_at IS NULL OR s.ended_at >= qb.prev_q_start)
            THEN s.customer_id END) AS customers_at_start,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE
            WHEN s.ended_at >= qb.prev_q_start
             AND s.ended_at < qb.current_q_start
            THEN s.customer_id END) AS churned_customers
    FROM quarter_bounds qb
    LEFT JOIN fct_subscriptions s
      ON s.customer_id IN (SELECT customer_id FROM customer_base)
)
SELECT
    quarter_label,
    quarter_start,
    churned_customers,
    customers_at_start,
    CASE
        WHEN customers_at_start = 0 THEN NULL
        ELSE churned_customers::DOUBLE / customers_at_start
    END AS churn_rate
FROM quarter_metrics
ORDER BY quarter_start DESC;

    WHERE COALESCE(dc.is_test, FALSE) = FALSE
      AND fs.mrr > 0
)

    month_start AS month,
    SUM(mrr) AS monthly_recurring_revenue
FROM active_subscriptions
GROUP BY 1

WITH month_ends AS (
    SELECT DATE '2025-12-31' AS as_of_date
    UNION ALL
    SELECT DATE '2026-05-03' AS as_of_date
), arr_by_date AS (
    SELECT
        m.as_of_date,
        COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN s.mrr > 0 THEN s.mrr ELSE 0 END), 0) * 12 AS arr
    FROM month_ends m
    JOIN fct_subscriptions s
      ON s.started_at < (m.as_of_date + INTERVAL 1 DAY)
     AND (s.ended_at IS NULL OR s.ended_at >= (m.as_of_date + INTERVAL 1 DAY))
     AND s.status = 'active'
    JOIN dim_customers c
      ON c.customer_id = s.customer_id
    WHERE COALESCE(c.is_test, FALSE) = FALSE
    GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT
    MAX(CASE WHEN as_of_date = DATE '2026-05-03' THEN arr END) AS arr_current_ytd,
    MAX(CASE WHEN as_of_date = DATE '2025-12-31' THEN arr END) AS arr_at_start_of_year,
    MAX(CASE WHEN as_of_date = DATE '2026-05-03' THEN arr END)
      - MAX(CASE WHEN as_of_date = DATE '2025-12-31' THEN arr END) AS arr_growth_ytd,
    CASE
      WHEN MAX(CASE WHEN as_of_date = DATE '2025-12-31' THEN arr END) = 0 THEN NULL
      ELSE (
        MAX(CASE WHEN as_of_date = DATE '2026-05-03' THEN arr END)
        - MAX(CASE WHEN as_of_date = DATE '2025-12-31' THEN arr END)
      ) / MAX(CASE WHEN as_of_date = DATE '2025-12-31' THEN arr END)
    END AS arr_growth_ytd_pct
FROM arr_by_date;

WITH q_start AS (
    SELECT TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01 00:00:00' AS period_start,
           TIMESTAMP '2026-04-01 00:00:00' AS period_end
),
starting_customers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT s.customer_id
    FROM fct_subscriptions s
    JOIN dim_customers c ON c.customer_id = s.customer_id
    CROSS JOIN q_start q
    WHERE COALESCE(c.is_test, FALSE) = FALSE
      AND s.started_at < q.period_start
      AND (s.ended_at IS NULL OR s.ended_at >= q.period_start)
),
true_churns AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT s.customer_id
    FROM fct_subscriptions s
    JOIN dim_customers c ON c.customer_id = s.customer_id
    CROSS JOIN q_start q
    WHERE COALESCE(c.is_test, FALSE) = FALSE
      AND s.status = 'cancelled'
      AND s.ended_at >= q.period_start
      AND s.ended_at < q.period_end
      AND NOT EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM fct_subscriptions s2
          WHERE s2.customer_id = s.customer_id
            AND s2.status = 'active'
            AND s2.started_at >= s.ended_at - INTERVAL 1 DAY
            AND s2.started_at <= s.ended_at + INTERVAL 1 DAY
            AND COALESCE(s2.mrr, 0) < COALESCE(s.mrr, 0)
      )
),
counts AS (
    SELECT
        (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM starting_customers) AS customers_at_start,
        (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM true_churns tc JOIN starting_customers sc ON tc.customer_id = sc.customer_id) AS churned_customers
)
SELECT
    churned_customers,
    customers_at_start,
    CASE
        WHEN customers_at_start = 0 THEN NULL
        ELSE CAST(churned_customers AS DOUBLE) / customers_at_start
    END AS churn_rate
FROM counts;

    SELECT TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01 00:00:00' AS period_start,
           TIMESTAMP '2026-04-01 00:00:00' AS period_end
),
starting_customers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT s.customer_id
    FROM fct_subscriptions s
    JOIN dim_customers c ON c.customer_id = s.customer_id
    CROSS JOIN q_start q
    WHERE COALESCE(c.is_test, FALSE) = FALSE
      AND s.started_at < q.period_start
      AND (s.ended_at IS NULL OR s.ended_at >= q.period_start)
),
true_churns AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT s.customer_id
    FROM fct_subscriptions s
    JOIN dim_customers c ON c.customer_id = s.customer_id
    CROSS JOIN q_start q
    WHERE COALESCE(c.is_test, FALSE) = FALSE
      AND s.status = 'cancelled'
      AND s.ended_at >= q.period_start
      AND s.ended_at < q.period_end
      AND NOT EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM fct_subscriptions s2
          WHERE s2.customer_id = s.customer_id
            AND s2.status = 'active'
            AND s2.started_at >= s.ended_at - INTERVAL 1 DAY
            AND s2.started_at <= s.ended_at + INTERVAL 1 DAY
            AND COALESCE(s2.mrr, 0) < COALESCE(s.mrr, 0)
      )
),
counts AS (
    SELECT
        (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM starting_customers) AS customers_at_start,
        (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM true_churns tc JOIN starting_customers sc ON tc.customer_id = sc.customer_id) AS churned_customers
)
SELECT
    churned_customers,
    customers_at_start,
    CASE
        WHEN customers_at_start = 0 THEN NULL
        ELSE CAST(churned_customers AS DOUBLE) / customers_at_start
    END AS churn_rate
FROM counts;

WITH params AS (
    SELECT DATE '2026-01-01' AS q_start, DATE '2026-04-01' AS q_end
), base_subs AS (
    SELECT
        s.sub_id,
        s.customer_id,
        s.mrr,
        s.started_at,
        s.ended_at,
        s.status
    FROM fct_subscriptions s
    JOIN dim_customers c
      ON c.customer_id = s.customer_id
    CROSS JOIN params p
    WHERE COALESCE(c.is_test, FALSE) = FALSE
      AND s.mrr > 0
      AND s.started_at < p.q_start
      AND (s.ended_at IS NULL OR s.ended_at >= p.q_start)
), cancellations_in_q AS (
    SELECT
        b.sub_id,
        b.customer_id,
        b.mrr,
        b.ended_at
    FROM base_subs b
    CROSS JOIN params p
    WHERE b.status = 'cancelled'
      AND b.ended_at >= p.q_start
      AND b.ended_at < p.q_end
), true_churn_cancellations AS (
    SELECT c.*
    FROM cancellations_in_q c
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM fct_subscriptions s2
        WHERE s2.customer_id = c.customer_id
          AND s2.status = 'active'
          AND s2.started_at >= c.ended_at - INTERVAL 1 DAY
          AND s2.started_at <= c.ended_at + INTERVAL 1 DAY
          AND s2.mrr > 0
          AND s2.mrr < c.mrr
    )
), starting_mrr AS (
    SELECT SUM(mrr) AS starting_mrr
    FROM base_subs
), churned_mrr AS (
    SELECT SUM(mrr) AS churned_mrr
    FROM true_churn_cancellations
)
SELECT ROUND(
    100.0 * (COALESCE(s.starting_mrr, 0) - COALESCE(c.churned_mrr, 0)) / NULLIF(COALESCE(s.starting_mrr, 0), 0),
    2
) AS gross_revenue_retention_q1_2026_pct
FROM starting_mrr s
CROSS JOIN churned_mrr c;

WITH q1_bounds AS (
    SELECT TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01 00:00:00' AS q_start,
           TIMESTAMP '2026-04-01 00:00:00' AS q_end
),
filtered_subs AS (
    SELECT s.*
    FROM fct_subscriptions s
    JOIN dim_customers c ON c.customer_id = s.customer_id
    WHERE COALESCE(c.is_test, FALSE) = FALSE
),
starting_subs AS (
    SELECT s.sub_id,
           s.customer_id,
           s.mrr AS start_mrr
    FROM filtered_subs s
    CROSS JOIN q1_bounds q
    WHERE s.started_at < q.q_start
      AND (s.ended_at IS NULL OR s.ended_at >= q.q_start)
      AND s.status IN ('active', 'cancelled')
      AND s.mrr > 0
),
customer_start_mrr AS (
    SELECT customer_id,
           SUM(start_mrr) AS start_mrr
    FROM starting_subs
    GROUP BY 1
),
customer_end_mrr AS (
    SELECT s.customer_id,
           SUM(CASE WHEN s.mrr > 0 THEN s.mrr ELSE 0 END) AS end_mrr
    FROM filtered_subs s
    CROSS JOIN q1_bounds q
    WHERE s.started_at < q.q_end
      AND (s.ended_at IS NULL OR s.ended_at >= q.q_end)
      AND s.status = 'active'
    GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(COALESCE(e.end_mrr, 0)) / NULLIF(SUM(cs.start_mrr), 0), 2) AS net_revenue_retention_pct
FROM customer_start_mrr cs
LEFT JOIN customer_end_mrr e USING (customer_id);

model_sql:
WITH latest_q AS (
  SELECT
    date_trunc('quarter', MAX(COALESCE(ended_at, started_at))) AS quarter_start,
    date_trunc('quarter', MAX(COALESCE(ended_at, started_at))) + INTERVAL 3 MONTH AS quarter_end
  FROM fct_subscriptions
), subs AS (
  SELECT
    s.sub_id,
    s.customer_id,
    s.started_at,
    s.ended_at,
    s.status,
    s.mrr,
    LEAD(s.started_at) OVER (PARTITION BY s.customer_id ORDER BY s.started_at, s.sub_id) AS next_started_at,
    LEAD(s.status) OVER (PARTITION BY s.customer_id ORDER BY s.started_at, s.sub_id) AS next_status,
    LEAD(s.mrr) OVER (PARTITION BY s.customer_id ORDER BY s.started_at, s.sub_id) AS next_mrr
  FROM fct_subscriptions s
  JOIN dim_customers c
    ON s.customer_id = c.customer_id
  WHERE COALESCE(c.is_test, FALSE) = FALSE
), quarter_starts AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT s.customer_id
  FROM subs s
  CROSS JOIN latest_q q
  WHERE s.started_at < q.quarter_start
    AND (s.ended_at IS NULL OR s.ended_at >= q.quarter_start)
    AND s.status IN ('active', 'cancelled')
), true_churns AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT s.customer_id
  FROM subs s
  CROSS JOIN latest_q q
  WHERE s.status = 'cancelled'
    AND s.ended_at >= q.quarter_start
    AND s.ended_at < q.quarter_end
    AND NOT (
      s.next_status = 'active'
      AND s.next_started_at IS NOT NULL
      AND s.next_started_at >= s.ended_at
      AND s.next_started_at <= s.ended_at + INTERVAL 1 DAY
      AND s.next_mrr < s.mrr
    )
    AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM subs s2
      WHERE s2.customer_id = s.customer_id
        AND s2.started_at >= s.ended_at
        AND s2.started_at <= s.ended_at + INTERVAL 1 DAY
        AND s2.status = 'active'
    )
)
SELECT
  q.quarter_start,
  q.quarter_end,
  COUNT(DISTINCT tc.customer_id) AS churned_customers,
  COUNT(DISTINCT qs.customer_id) AS customers_at_start_of_quarter,
  CASE
    WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT qs.customer_id) = 0 THEN NULL
    ELSE COUNT(DISTINCT tc.customer_id) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT qs.customer_id)
  END AS churn_rate
FROM latest_q q
LEFT JOIN quarter_starts qs ON TRUE
LEFT JOIN true_churns tc ON qs.customer_id = tc.customer_id
GROUP BY 1, 2;

WITH cancellation_events AS (
    SELECT
        s.sub_id,
        s.customer_id,
        s.plan,
        s.mrr,
        s.started_at,
        s.ended_at,
        s.status,
        c.is_test,
        CASE
            WHEN EXISTS (
                SELECT 1
                FROM fct_subscriptions s2
                WHERE s2.customer_id = s.customer_id
                  AND s2.status = 'active'
                  AND s.ended_at IS NOT NULL
                  AND s2.started_at BETWEEN s.ended_at - INTERVAL 1 DAY AND s.ended_at + INTERVAL 1 DAY
                  AND COALESCE(s2.mrr, 0) < COALESCE(s.mrr, 0)
            ) THEN 1 ELSE 0
        END AS is_downgrade_cancellation
    FROM fct_subscriptions s
    LEFT JOIN dim_customers c
      ON c.customer_id = s.customer_id
    WHERE s.status = 'cancelled'
      AND COALESCE(c.is_test, FALSE) = FALSE
), v1_definition_issues AS (
    SELECT 'Used raw cancelled subscriptions as churn numerator' AS issue
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'Counted downgrade-cancellations as churn when a replacement active subscription started within 1 day at lower MRR'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'Did not explicitly exclude test accounts'
), evidence AS (
    SELECT
        COUNT(*) AS cancelled_subscriptions,
        SUM(is_downgrade_cancellation) AS downgrade_cancellations,
        ROUND(100.0 * SUM(is_downgrade_cancellation) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS pct_cancelled_that_are_downgrades
    FROM cancellation_events
)
SELECT
    i.issue,
    e.cancelled_subscriptions,
    e.downgrade_cancellations,
    e.pct_cancelled_that_are_downgrades
FROM v1_definition_issues i
CROSS JOIN evidence e;

    SELECT
        s.sub_id,
        s.customer_id,
        s.started_at,
        s.ended_at,
        s.status,
        LEAD(s.started_at) OVER (PARTITION BY s.customer_id ORDER BY s.started_at, s.sub_id) AS next_started_at,
        LEAD(s.status) OVER (PARTITION BY s.customer_id ORDER BY s.started_at, s.sub_id) AS next_status
    FROM fct_subscriptions s
    JOIN dim_customers c ON c.customer_id = s.customer_id
    WHERE COALESCE(c.is_test, FALSE) = FALSE
), true_churns AS (
    SELECT
        customer_id,
        ended_at AS churned_at,
        DATE_TRUNC('quarter', ended_at) AS quarter_start
    FROM subscription_events
    WHERE status = 'cancelled'
      AND ended_at IS NOT NULL
      AND NOT (
          next_status = 'active'
          AND next_started_at IS NOT NULL
          AND ABS(DATEDIFF('day', ended_at, next_started_at)) <= 1
      )
), quarter_starts AS (
    SELECT DATE_TRUNC('quarter', CURRENT_DATE) AS quarter_start
    UNION ALL
    SELECT DATE_TRUNC('quarter', CURRENT_DATE) - INTERVAL '3 months'
), customer_quarter_status AS (
    SELECT
        q.quarter_start,
        c.customer_id,
        MAX(CASE
            WHEN s.started_at < q.quarter_start
             AND (s.ended_at IS NULL OR s.ended_at >= q.quarter_start)
            THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_at_start,
        MAX(CASE
            WHEN tc.churned_at >= q.quarter_start
             AND tc.churned_at < q.quarter_start + INTERVAL '3 months'
            THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS churned_in_quarter
    FROM quarter_starts q
    JOIN dim_customers c
      ON COALESCE(c.is_test, FALSE) = FALSE
    LEFT JOIN fct_subscriptions s
      ON s.customer_id = c.customer_id
    LEFT JOIN true_churns tc
      ON tc.customer_id = c.customer_id
     AND tc.quarter_start = q.quarter_start
    GROUP BY 1, 2
)

  SELECT
    event_id,
    event_type,
    CASE
      WHEN timezone = 'America/Los_Angeles' THEN "timestamp" + INTERVAL 8 HOUR
      ELSE "timestamp"
    END AS ts_utc,
    COALESCE(
      CAST(json_extract_string(properties_jsonb, '$.opp_id') AS VARCHAR),
      CAST(json_extract_string(properties_jsonb, '$.oppId') AS VARCHAR)
    ) AS opp_id
  FROM fct_events
  WHERE event_type IN ('opp_won', 'opp_lost')
), q1_2026 AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM normalized_opps
  WHERE ts_utc >= TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01 00:00:00'
    AND ts_utc < TIMESTAMP '2026-04-01 00:00:00'
), deduped AS (
  SELECT
    opp_id,
    event_type,
    ts_utc,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY opp_id ORDER BY ts_utc DESC, event_id DESC) AS rn
  FROM q1_2026
  WHERE opp_id IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
  SUM(CASE WHEN event_type = 'opp_won' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS won_opportunities,
  SUM(CASE WHEN event_type IN ('opp_won', 'opp_lost') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS closed_opportunities,
  CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN event_type = 'opp_won' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS DOUBLE)
    / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN event_type IN ('opp_won', 'opp_lost') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS win_rate
FROM deduped
WHERE rn = 1;

      CAST(json_extract_string(properties_jsonb, '$.oppId') AS VARCHAR)

  WHERE ts_utc >= TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01 00:00:00'
    AND ts_utc < TIMESTAMP '2026-04-01 00:00:00'
), deduped AS (
  SELECT
    opp_id,
    event_type,
    ts_utc,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY opp_id ORDER BY ts_utc DESC, event_id DESC) AS rn
  FROM q1_2026
  WHERE opp_id IS NOT NULL
)

  SUM(CASE WHEN event_type IN ('opp_won', 'opp_lost') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS closed_opportunities,

    / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN event_type IN ('opp_won', 'opp_lost') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS win_rate
FROM deduped

    date_trunc('quarter', current_date) AS current_q_start,
    date_trunc('quarter', current_date) + INTERVAL '3 months' AS next_q_start,
    date_trunc('quarter', current_date) - INTERVAL '3 months' AS previous_q_start
), quarter_rates AS (
  SELECT
    'current_quarter' AS quarter_label,
    100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN s.status = 'cancelled' AND s.started_at >= qb.current_q_start AND s.started_at < qb.next_q_start THEN s.mrr ELSE 0 END)
      / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN s.started_at >= qb.current_q_start AND s.started_at < qb.next_q_start THEN s.mrr ELSE 0 END), 0) AS churn_rate_pct
  FROM fct_subscriptions s
  CROSS JOIN quarter_bounds qb

  UNION ALL

  SELECT
    'previous_quarter' AS quarter_label,
    100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN s.status = 'cancelled' AND s.started_at >= qb.previous_q_start AND s.started_at < qb.current_q_start THEN s.mrr ELSE 0 END)
      / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN s.started_at >= qb.previous_q_start AND s.started_at < qb.current_q_start THEN s.mrr ELSE 0 END), 0) AS churn_rate_pct
  FROM fct_subscriptions s
  CROSS JOIN quarter_bounds qb
)
SELECT quarter_label, churn_rate_pct

ORDER BY CASE quarter_label WHEN 'current_quarter' THEN 1 WHEN 'previous_quarter' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END;

  FROM fct_invoices i
  JOIN dim_customers c ON c.customer_id = i.customer_id
  WHERE i.paid_at >= DATE '2026-01-01'

    AND i.status = 'paid'
    AND c.is_test = false
),
period_cogs AS (
  SELECT period_month,
    COALESCE(
      MAX(CASE WHEN source = 'cost_of_goods_sold' THEN amount END),
      MAX(CASE WHEN source = 'cost_of_revenue' THEN amount END)
    ) AS dedupped_cogs
  FROM fct_cogs
  WHERE period_month >= DATE '2026-01-01'
    AND period_month < DATE '2026-03-31'
  GROUP BY period_month
),
totals AS (
  SELECT
    SUM(amount) AS revenue_total,
    (SELECT SUM(dedupped_cogs) FROM period_cogs) AS cogs_total
  FROM revenue
)
SELECT
  ((revenue_total - COALESCE(cogs_total, revenue_total * 0.25))
   / NULLIF(revenue_total, 0)) * 100 AS gross_margin_pct
FROM totals;

churned_in_period AS (

  WHERE c.is_test = false

)

  / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT sc.customer_id), 0) * 100 AS churn_rate_pct
FROM starting_cohort sc;

model_sql:
WITH revenue AS (
  SELECT i.paid_at, i.amount
  FROM fct_invoices i
  JOIN dim_customers c ON c.customer_id = i.customer_id
  WHERE i.paid_at >= DATE '2026-01-01'
    AND i.paid_at < DATE '2026-03-31' + INTERVAL 1 DAY
    AND i.status = 'paid'
    AND c.is_test = false
),
period_cogs AS (
  SELECT period_month,
    COALESCE(
      MAX(CASE WHEN source = 'cost_of_goods_sold' THEN amount END),
      MAX(CASE WHEN source = 'cost_of_revenue' THEN amount END)
    ) AS dedupped_cogs
  FROM fct_cogs
  WHERE period_month >= DATE '2026-01-01'
    AND period_month < DATE '2026-03-31' + INTERVAL 1 DAY
  GROUP BY period_month
),
totals AS (
  SELECT
    SUM(amount) AS revenue_total,
    (SELECT SUM(dedupped_cogs) FROM period_cogs) AS cogs_total
  FROM revenue
)
SELECT
  ((revenue_total - COALESCE(cogs_total, revenue_total * 0.25))
   / NULLIF(revenue_total, 0)) * 100 AS gross_margin_pct
FROM totals;

    c.customer_id,
    SUM(CASE
          WHEN s.started_at < DATE '2026-01-01'
            AND (s.ended_at IS NULL OR s.ended_at > DATE '2026-01-01')

  LEFT JOIN fct_subscriptions s
    ON s.customer_id = c.customer_id
  WHERE c.is_test = false
    AND c.signup_date < DATE '2026-01-01'
  GROUP BY c.customer_id
),
ending AS (
  SELECT
    c.customer_id,
    SUM(CASE
          WHEN s.started_at < DATE '2026-03-31'
            AND (s.ended_at IS NULL OR s.ended_at > DATE '2026-03-31')
            AND s.mrr > 0
          THEN s.mrr ELSE 0 END) AS arr_end
  FROM dim_customers c
  LEFT JOIN fct_subscriptions s
    ON s.customer_id = c.customer_id
  WHERE c.is_test = false
    AND c.signup_date < DATE '2026-01-01'
  GROUP BY c.customer_id
)
SELECT

    / NULLIF(SUM(s.arr_start), 0) * 100 AS gross_retention_pct

WITH starting_customers AS (
  SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.customer_id) AS cust_count
  FROM dim_customers c
  JOIN fct_subscriptions s ON s.customer_id = c.customer_id
  WHERE c.is_test = false
    AND c.signup_date < DATE '2025-01-01'
    AND s.status = 'active'
    AND s.started_at < DATE '2025-01-01'
    AND (s.ended_at IS NULL OR s.ended_at > DATE '2025-01-01')
),
churned AS (
  SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.customer_id) AS cust_count
  FROM dim_customers c
  WHERE c.is_test = false
    AND c.churned_at >= DATE '2025-01-01'
    AND c.churned_at < DATE '2026-01-01'
),
revenue AS (
  SELECT SUM(i.amount) AS rev
  FROM fct_invoices i
  JOIN dim_customers c ON c.customer_id = i.customer_id
  WHERE (
      CASE
        WHEN i.processor = 'legacy_braintree'
          THEN i.paid_at AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York' AT TIME ZONE 'America/Los_Angeles'
        ELSE i.paid_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AT TIME ZONE 'America/Los_Angeles'
      END
    ) >= DATE '2025-01-01'
    AND (
      CASE
        WHEN i.processor = 'legacy_braintree'
          THEN i.paid_at AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York' AT TIME ZONE 'America/Los_Angeles'
        ELSE i.paid_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AT TIME ZONE 'America/Los_Angeles'
      END
    ) < DATE '2026-01-01'
    AND i.status = 'paid'
    AND c.is_test = false
)
SELECT
  ((revenue.rev / NULLIF(starting_customers.cust_count, 0)) * 0.75)
    / NULLIF(churned.cust_count::DOUBLE / NULLIF(starting_customers.cust_count, 0), 0) AS ltv
FROM starting_customers, churned, revenue;

WITH params AS (
  SELECT TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-03-31 23:59:59+00' AS period_end
), open_opps AS (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(e.properties_jsonb->>'opp_id', e.properties_jsonb->>'oppId') AS opp_id,
    CAST(COALESCE(e.properties_jsonb->>'deal_value', e.properties_jsonb->>'dealValue') AS DOUBLE) AS deal_value
  FROM fct_events e
  CROSS JOIN params p
  WHERE e.event_type = 'opp_created'
    AND timezone('UTC', timezone(COALESCE(e.timezone, 'UTC'), e."timestamp")) < p.period_end
    AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM fct_events e2
      WHERE COALESCE(e2.properties_jsonb->>'opp_id', e2.properties_jsonb->>'oppId')
          = COALESCE(e.properties_jsonb->>'opp_id', e.properties_jsonb->>'oppId')
        AND e2.event_type IN ('opp_won', 'opp_lost', 'opp_no_decision')
        AND timezone('UTC', timezone(COALESCE(e2.timezone, 'UTC'), e2."timestamp")) < p.period_end
    )
)
SELECT SUM(deal_value) / 5000000.0 AS coverage_ratio
FROM open_opps;

      ELSE i.paid_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AT TIME ZONE 'America/Los_Angeles'
    END) AS month_start,
    SUM(i.amount) AS revenue
  FROM fct_invoices i
  JOIN dim_customers c ON c.customer_id = i.customer_id
  WHERE CASE
      WHEN i.processor = 'legacy_braintree'
        THEN i.paid_at AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York' AT TIME ZONE 'America/Los_Angeles'
      ELSE i.paid_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AT TIME ZONE 'America/Los_Angeles'
    END >= TIMESTAMP '2026-02-01'
    AND CASE
      WHEN i.processor = 'legacy_braintree'
        THEN i.paid_at AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York' AT TIME ZONE 'America/Los_Angeles'
      ELSE i.paid_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AT TIME ZONE 'America/Los_Angeles'
    END < TIMESTAMP '2026-04-01'
    AND i.status = 'paid'
    AND c.is_test = false
  GROUP BY 1

  SELECT DATE '2026-01-01' AS period_start, DATE '2026-03-31' AS period_end
),
starting_cohort AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT c.customer_id
  FROM dim_customers c
  JOIN fct_subscriptions s ON s.customer_id = c.customer_id
  CROSS JOIN params p
  WHERE c.is_test = false
    AND c.signup_date < p.period_start
    AND s.started_at < p.period_start
    AND (s.ended_at IS NULL OR s.ended_at > p.period_start)
),
churned_in_period AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT c.customer_id
  FROM dim_customers c
  CROSS JOIN params p
  WHERE c.is_test = false
    AND c.churned_at >= p.period_start
    AND c.churned_at < p.period_end
)
SELECT
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN sc.customer_id IN (SELECT customer_id FROM churned_in_period) THEN sc.customer_id END)::DOUBLE
  / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT sc.customer_id), 0) * 100 AS churn_rate_pct
FROM starting_cohort sc;

WITH quarter_periods AS (
  SELECT 'current_quarter' AS period_label,
         DATE '2026-01-01' AS period_start,
         DATE '2026-03-31' + INTERVAL 1 DAY AS period_end
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'previous_quarter' AS period_label,
         DATE '2025-10-01' AS period_start,
         DATE '2025-12-31' + INTERVAL 1 DAY AS period_end
),
starting_cohort AS (
  SELECT qp.period_label, c.customer_id
  FROM quarter_periods qp
  JOIN dim_customers c ON c.is_test = false
  JOIN fct_subscriptions s ON s.customer_id = c.customer_id
  WHERE c.signup_date < qp.period_start
    AND s.started_at < qp.period_start
    AND (s.ended_at IS NULL OR s.ended_at > qp.period_start)
  GROUP BY 1, 2
),
churned_in_period AS (
  SELECT qp.period_label, c.customer_id
  FROM quarter_periods qp
  JOIN dim_customers c ON c.is_test = false
  WHERE c.churned_at >= qp.period_start
    AND c.churned_at < qp.period_end
  GROUP BY 1, 2
)
SELECT
  qp.period_label,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN cip.customer_id IS NOT NULL THEN sc.customer_id END)::DOUBLE
    / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT sc.customer_id), 0) * 100 AS churn_rate_pct
FROM quarter_periods qp
LEFT JOIN starting_cohort sc
  ON sc.period_label = qp.period_label
LEFT JOIN churned_in_period cip
  ON cip.period_label = qp.period_label
 AND cip.customer_id = sc.customer_id
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY CASE qp.period_label WHEN 'current_quarter' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END;

)

FROM opp_outcomes

  SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('quarter', started_at) AS cohort_quarter,
    customer_id
  FROM fct_subscriptions
  WHERE started_at IS NOT NULL
),
churns AS (
  SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('quarter', churned_at) AS churn_quarter,
    customer_id
  FROM dim_customers
  WHERE churned_at IS NOT NULL
),
quarterly_metrics AS (
  SELECT
    c.cohort_quarter,
    COUNT(DISTINCT c.customer_id) AS cohort_size,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ch.customer_id) AS churned_count
  FROM quarterly_cohorts c
  LEFT JOIN churns ch
    ON c.customer_id = ch.customer_id
    AND ch.churn_quarter = c.cohort_quarter
  GROUP BY c.cohort_quarter
)
SELECT
  cohort_quarter,
  ROUND(100.0 * churned_count / NULLIF(cohort_size, 0), 2) AS churn_rate_pct
FROM quarterly_metrics
WHERE cohort_quarter >= DATE_TRUNC('quarter', CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '1 quarter')
  AND cohort_quarter < DATE_TRUNC('quarter', CURRENT_DATE + INTERVAL '1 quarter')
ORDER BY cohort_quarter DESC
LIMIT 2

WITH q1_2026_events AS (
  SELECT
    event_id,
    event_type,
    timestamp
  FROM fct_events
  WHERE timestamp >= '2026-01-01' AND timestamp < '2026-04-01'
    AND event_type IN ('opportunity_won', 'opportunity_lost')
),
win_rate_calc AS (
  SELECT
    COUNT(CASE WHEN event_type = 'opportunity_won' THEN 1 END) AS wins,
    COUNT(*) AS total_opportunities
  FROM q1_2026_events
)
SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN total_opportunities > 0 THEN ROUND(100.0 * wins / total_opportunities, 2)
    ELSE 0
  END AS win_rate_percent
FROM win_rate_calc;

WITH recent_quarter AS (
  SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('quarter', MAX(started_at)) AS quarter_start
  FROM fct_subscriptions
),
active_start AS (
  SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT s.customer_id) AS active_customers
  FROM fct_subscriptions s
  INNER JOIN dim_customers c ON s.customer_id = c.customer_id
  CROSS JOIN recent_quarter rq
  WHERE s.started_at < rq.quarter_start + INTERVAL '3 months'
    AND (s.ended_at IS NULL OR s.ended_at >= rq.quarter_start)
    AND c.is_test = false
),
churned_in_quarter AS (
  SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT s.customer_id) AS churned_customers
  FROM fct_subscriptions s
  INNER JOIN dim_customers c ON s.customer_id = c.customer_id
  CROSS JOIN recent_quarter rq
  WHERE s.status = 'cancelled'
    AND s.ended_at >= rq.quarter_start
    AND s.ended_at < rq.quarter_start + INTERVAL '3 months'
    AND c.is_test = false
    AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM fct_subscriptions s2
      WHERE s2.customer_id = s.customer_id
        AND s2.started_at BETWEEN s.ended_at - INTERVAL '1 day' AND s.ended_at + INTERVAL '1 day'
        AND s2.status = 'active'
    )
)
SELECT
  ROUND(100.0 * churned_customers / NULLIF(active_customers, 0), 2) AS churn_rate_pct
FROM active_start, churned_in_quarter

WITH current_quarter AS (
  SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('quarter', CURRENT_DATE) AS quarter_start,
    DATE_TRUNC('quarter', CURRENT_DATE) + INTERVAL '3 months' - INTERVAL '1 day' AS quarter_end
),
previous_quarter AS (
  SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('quarter', CURRENT_DATE) - INTERVAL '3 months' AS quarter_start,
    DATE_TRUNC('quarter', CURRENT_DATE) - INTERVAL '1 day' AS quarter_end
),
current_qtr_metrics AS (
  SELECT
    'Current Quarter' AS period,
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN s.status = 'cancelled' THEN s.mrr ELSE 0 END), 0) AS cancelled_mrr,
    COALESCE(SUM(s.mrr), 0) AS total_mrr
  FROM stg_subscriptions s
  CROSS JOIN current_quarter cq
  WHERE s.ended_at >= cq.quarter_start
    AND s.ended_at <= cq.quarter_end
),
previous_qtr_metrics AS (
  SELECT
    'Previous Quarter' AS period,
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN s.status = 'cancelled' THEN s.mrr ELSE 0 END), 0) AS cancelled_mrr,
    COALESCE(SUM(s.mrr), 0) AS total_mrr
  FROM stg_subscriptions s
  CROSS JOIN previous_quarter pq
  WHERE s.ended_at >= pq.quarter_start
    AND s.ended_at <= pq.quarter_end
)
SELECT
  period,
  CASE
    WHEN total_mrr = 0 THEN NULL
    ELSE cancelled_mrr / total_mrr
  END AS churn_rate
FROM (
  SELECT * FROM current_qtr_metrics
  UNION ALL
  SELECT * FROM previous_qtr_metrics
)
ORDER BY period DESC

WITH revenue AS (
  SELECT i.paid_at, i.amount
  FROM fct_invoices i
  JOIN dim_customers c ON c.customer_id = i.customer_id
  WHERE i.paid_at >= DATE '2026-01-01'
    AND i.paid_at < DATE '2026-04-01'
    AND i.status = 'paid'
    AND c.is_test = false
),
period_cogs AS (
  SELECT period_month,
    COALESCE(
      MAX(CASE WHEN source = 'cost_of_goods_sold' THEN amount END),
      MAX(CASE WHEN source = 'cost_of_revenue'    THEN amount END)
    ) AS dedupped_cogs
  FROM fct_cogs
  WHERE period_month >= DATE '2026-01-01'
    AND period_month < DATE '2026-04-01'
  GROUP BY period_month
),
totals AS (
  SELECT
    SUM(amount) AS revenue_total,
    (SELECT SUM(dedupped_cogs) FROM period_cogs) AS cogs_total
  FROM revenue
)
SELECT
  ((revenue_total - COALESCE(cogs_total, revenue_total * 0.25))
   / NULLIF(revenue_total, 0)) * 100 AS gross_margin_pct
FROM totals

WITH opp_outcomes AS (
  SELECT
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN event_type = 'opp_won'
                        THEN COALESCE(properties_jsonb->>'opp_id',
                                      properties_jsonb->>'oppId') END) AS won,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN event_type = 'opp_lost'
                        THEN COALESCE(properties_jsonb->>'opp_id',
                                      properties_jsonb->>'oppId') END) AS lost
  FROM fct_events
  WHERE (timestamp AT TIME ZONE timezone AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') >= TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01 00:00:00'
    AND (timestamp AT TIME ZONE timezone AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') < TIMESTAMP '2026-04-01 00:00:00'
    AND event_type IN ('opp_won', 'opp_lost')
)
SELECT
  won::float / NULLIF(won + lost, 0) * 100 AS win_rate_pct
FROM opp_outcomes
